entities.name: Metal Island
entities.description: A possibly fictional pocket plane reached through the Riddle Gate on Esper, where Tezzeret fought Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A planeswalker who tried to defeat his former employer Nicol Bolas on the Metal Island.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder dragon planeswalker who confronted Tezzeret; a simulacrum was sent.

entities.name: Baltrice
entities.description: Arrived at the island and was resuscitated by Tezzeret.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker who arrived, was resuscitated by Tezzeret and fled.

entities.name: Riddle Gate
entities.description: A gate on Esper used to reach the Metal Island.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: The plane with the Riddle Gate.

events.summary: Nicol Bolas arrived and demanded answers about Tezzeret's search for etherium; Baltrice, Jace Beleren and Sharuum followed.
events.quote: As soon as she left again, a terrible fight broke out

events.summary: A terrible fight ended with Bolas apparently victorious, but Tezzeret had engineered Bolas's weakening and was the true victor.
events.quote: This was revealed to have been engineered by Tezzeret

events.summary: Tezzeret resuscitated Baltrice and Jace, Jace fled, and Tezzeret left Bolas trapped on the island.
events.quote: Jace fled and Tezzeret left Bolas trapped on the island.

events.summary: Bolas had predicted Tezzeret's actions and sent only a simulacrum.
events.quote: Bolas had predicted all of Tezzeret's actions

relations.note: Tezzeret tried to defeat his former employer.
relations.quote: Tezzeret tried to defeat his former employer
